⌂NestMatch
PRIVACY NOTICE

Your demo activity stays on your device.

Effective October 12, 2026. NestMatch is a public portfolio demo and does not require an account.

Information saved locally

The shortlist uses browser storage to remember preferences, saved and passed samples, private notes, and progress labels. The previous demo separately remembers role, matches, profile text, and compressed photos. This information remains in the browser you use and is not uploaded to a NestMatch server or shared with other visitors.

Hosting

The rental cost calculator processes your entries in the page without saving them or uploading them. Reloading the page clears those entries.

Cloudflare hosts this site and processes connection information, such as IP addresses and request metadata, to deliver and secure it. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

Optional maps

Maps load only when you select “View neighborhood map.” This connects your browser to OpenStreetMap, which receives connection information and the public sample neighborhood coordinates. Your private preferences and notes are not included. See OpenStreetMap’s privacy policy. Close the map to remove the embedded frame.

Referral links in the previous demo

The share control creates a link with standard campaign labels so a future privacy-respecting analytics setup can distinguish invited visits. This version does not send those labels to a NestMatch analytics service.

Advertising and cookies

NestMatch does not currently run third-party advertising or ad-personalization cookies. This notice will be updated before advertising or external analytics are activated.

Your choices

Use “Clear shortlist data” for new shortlist preferences, decisions, and notes. This does not remove old profiles or photos. In the previous demo, use “Reset demo” to clear matching activity and the profile editor’s “Clear profile” control to remove profile information. Clearing this site’s browser storage also removes all locally saved demo data.
